question_text: Will the **high temp in Austin** be <83° on Nov 15, 2025?
resolution_criteria:
If the highest temperature recorded in Austin Bergstrom for November 15, 2025 as reported by the National Weather Service's Climatological Report (Daily), is less than 83°, then the market resolves to Yes.
Not all weather data is the same. While checking a source like AccuWeather or Google Weather may help guide your decision, the official and final value used to determine this market is the highest temperature as reported by the corresponding NWS Climatological Report (Daily) linked in the rules above. Preliminary NWS reporting and measurement methods may be subject to underlying rounding and conversion nuances. Traders should exercise caution when interpreting preliminary NWS data.

highlights:
Record weekend highs in Austin may lead to severe storms next week. See weather forecast By Mary Wasson , Newsroom MeteorologistNov 15, 2025 This weekend will be dry and warmer than normal, but next week is looking wet with the possibility of heavy rain. This ... If you were hoping for a weekend that feels like fall in Texas, unfortunately this won’t be it. We’ll have to wait until next weekend for more seasonal weather but before that arrives, we could see our weather become a bit ... We’ll wake up Saturday morning to a mostly cloudy sky and temperatures will feel quite muggy in the low to mid-60s. Luckily, southerly winds will be a bit breezy, with gusts climbing to 20 mph as early as 9 a.m. Those winds will help clear the clouds quickly, with plenty of sunshine expected by lunchtime. Temperatures will climb into the mid-80s, slightly below the record high of 90 degrees for the day, set in 1951. Sunday’s weather will be similar to Saturday’s. The morning will begin with a mostly cloudy sky and temperatures in the low to mid-60s. Winds will be lighter out of the south at 5 to 10 mph. Clouds will clear by mid-morning, giving way to a mostly sunny afternoon with highs climbing into the upper 80s, nearing the record high of 87 degrees set in 1938. Near-record high temperatures are expected through Tuesday before a cooldown moves in behind a powerful cold front in ...
